name: Lior
self_text: I am a Spanish non-binary person in my late 30s. My academic background is in nursing, but these days I am spending my time studying programming. When I am not staring at a screen, I love heading outdoors for some birdwatching to clear my head and appreciate nature. Regarding my study routine, I have found that I work best when studying independently side by side with someone else. While I appreciate the autonomy of working on my own tasks, I need talking things through as we go to keep my momentum. I am available to meet in person to get some work done, and I am free on Saturday afternoon or Sunday afternoon.
